latHint: Think what you pay to cross a bridge - not a bell.
pivHint: A bell TOLLs slowly in the chimes - but a bridge TOLL is the ______ you pay to cross.
winText: Pay up. TOLL was the pivot - a slow bell to the PRICE of crossing.
lossText: PRICE - what you must pay. TOLL was the pivot: a bell's TOLL to a bridge TOLL.
